quote: I didn't read every migration line by line
context: **How I found them.** I didn't rely on a regex. I used an AST scan of every `execute`, `executemany` and `executescript` call in all 120 migrations. It flagged any call whose SQL argument wasn't a plain string literal. That also catches SQL assembled in steps in a variable. I read each hit. The only other non-literal arguments are `DDL` and `SCHEMA` constants, which I confirmed are literals. The remaining `sql` variables in 0083, 0097 and 0108 now only hold fixed text with `?` placeholders. I didn't read every migration line by line, so a helper that bypasses `.execute*` entirely would not have been caught.
method: AST scan of every execute, executemany, and executescript call in all 120 migrations
